summary: Produced docs/product/V1_CLOSEOUT_ADOPTION_GUIDE.md and linked it from README. The report is sourced from live Sprint 10/v1 queue state, operation/ledger evidence, command registry counts, current architecture docs, and S10T07 release-gate verification.
